parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id,
  l.whatsapp_name,
  l.phone_number,
  l.service,
  l.city,
  l.requirement,
  l.clickup_task_id,
  l.clickup_task_url,
  s.id AS seller_id,
  s.name AS seller_name,
  s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  s.clickup_user_id
FROM leads l
JOIN sellers s ON s.id = l.assigned_seller_id
WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
  AND l.deleted_at IS NULL;

WITH updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    lead_status_id = ls.id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
    AND ls.code = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'notified' ELSE 'error' END
  RETURNING l.id
),
audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (
    event_name,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    result,
    before_payload,
    after_payload,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    $3::text,
    'lead',
    ul.id,
    'system',
    'n8n',
    $4::text,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($6::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM updated_lead ul
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT ul.id AS lead_id, ai.id AS audit_id
FROM updated_lead ul
LEFT JOIN audit_insert ai ON TRUE;
